name: app/app-shell
title: AppShell
summary: The signed-in frame of an app or console, laid out as a full-width product dashboard: a fixed left sidebar (workspace switcher, quick search, grouped navigation, collapse toggle) and a main column (top bar, the page in <main>, a quiet footer). No centred page container.

props.name: navLabel
props.description: Noun for the drawer buttons and the collapse toggle ("Open navigation", "Collapse navigation").

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Render with the sidebar collapsed to the icon rail, from the app's preference cookie.

props.name: persist
props.description: Cookie the enhancement script writes the collapse choice to ("collapsed" or "expanded"). Must match ^[\w-]+$.

props.name: sidebarLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the sidebar landmark.

props.name: accent
props.description: The brand's mineral. Its brand fill (`--color-<mineral>-brand`, text `-on-brand`) colours primary actions and the current nav indicator inside the shell, through `--app-accent` / `--app-accent-foreground`. Text links and the focus ring keep the contrast-safe `--primary` / `--ring`.

props.name: id
props.description: Prefix for the shell's ids (`<id>-sidebar`, `<id>-collapse`); unique per page.

slots.name: workspace
slots.description: Top of the sidebar: the product mark and the current workspace.

slots.name: search
slots.description: Under the workspace: the button that opens the command palette.

slots.name: nav
slots.description: The navigation. Rendered once, in the sidebar.

slots.name: sidebar-footer
slots.description: Beside the collapse toggle at the foot of the sidebar.

slots.name: brand
slots.description: The mark in the top bar below 64rem, where the sidebar is a drawer.

slots.name: account
slots.description: The last item in the top bar.

slots.name: overlay
slots.description: Popovers that sit outside the layout.

behaviour: From 64rem the sidebar is a sticky 16.25rem column and the main column fills the rest of the viewport; nothing centres the page.
Below 64rem the same <aside> is a Popover API drawer, opened by the top bar's menu button and closed by its close button, Escape or a click outside (light dismiss). The nav is never rendered twice.

Collapse is a real checkbox. Checked, the sidebar becomes a 3.5rem icon rail: labels, group names, badges, the wordmark and the search text hide; tooltips show the label; a nested group becomes one link to its first item.
`collapsed` sets the checkbox from the server, so a persisted preference renders without a flash.
Headings inside the shell use the body sans; only the wordmark keeps the serif.
The footer renders only when there are `footerLinks` or a `footer` slot.

default.description: Expanded, every slot filled, one footer link.

collapsed.description: Rendered collapsed from the preference cookie.

accent.description: Nyuchi's overlay: the gold brand fill.

keyboard: Tab reaches the menu button (below 64rem), the top-bar slots, then the page.
Escape closes the drawer (platform light dismiss).
With the script: Escape hides any tooltip until the pointer or focus moves (WCAG 1.4.13).
focus: <main> has tabindex="-1" so a skip link can move focus to it.
The collapse label shows the ring when its visually hidden checkbox has keyboard focus.
aria: The menu and close buttons are named "Open <navLabel>" / "Close <navLabel>".
The collapse checkbox is named "Collapse <navLabel>" by a visually hidden span.

theming.brandOverlay: `accent` names the brand mineral and sets `data-accent` on the shell, and the shell's stylesheet sets `--app-accent` / `--app-accent-foreground` from it (never an inline style, so a CSP needs no style-src-attr 'unsafe-inline'), which primary Buttons and the SideNav indicator read; the theme's `--primary` and `--ring` come from the brand overlay stylesheet. Nothing else changes: the grid, the sidebar width, the top bar and every spacing are the same in every brand.

noJs.without: The drawer opens and closes (Popover API), collapse works (a checkbox and :has()), every link works.
noJs.with: The collapse choice is written to the `persist` cookie, and Escape dismisses tooltips (WCAG 1.4.13).

responsive: < 64rem: the sidebar is an off-canvas drawer, min(18rem, 86vw) wide, over a 30% foreground backdrop; the `brand` slot shows in the top bar.
≥ 64rem: grid of 16.25rem (3.5rem collapsed) and minmax(0, 1fr); the menu button and `brand` slot hide.
Main padding grows 16 → 24 → 32px at sm and lg; nothing scrolls sideways at 320px.
contract:
contract
  slot is "app-shell"
  uses app-sidebar
  uses app-topbar
  uses app-footer
  when default shows button "Open menu"
  when default shows button "Close menu"
  when default shows label "Collapse menu"
  when bare slot is "app-shell"
end

checks.say: The sidebar is one <aside> popover, named by sidebarLabel.
The page is in exactly one <main id="main" tabindex="-1">.
The nav slot is rendered once.
The menu button opens the drawer.
The close button hides the drawer.
Collapse is a checkbox, unchecked by default.
`persist` names the cookie on the shell.
`accent` names the mineral on the shell; the shell's stylesheet sets `--app-accent` / `--app-accent-foreground` from its brand fill. No inline style.
No accent, no data-accent and no inline style.

gaps: The collapse toggle is 32px on every pointer; on a touch screen at 64rem or wider it is under the 44px target the rest of the shell keeps (WCAG 2.5.8 is met at 24px; 2.5.5 is not).
